title: Present Perfect e Vocabulário do Cotidiano
rawContent: TODAY’S TAKEAWAYSGRAMMARVOCABULARYPRONUNCIATIONoven: fornobake: assarlose – lost – lost puddle: poçapoodle: raça de cachorroeat – ate – eaten have lunch: almoçarhurt: machucar, ferirFURTHER PRACTICE WITH PRESENT PERFECT CONNECTED TO NOWExample: - Lisa’s phone battery was at 35%, but now it’s at 100%.- Lisa has charged her phone.Present perfect: subject + have / has + past participleRegular verbs have the same form in past simple and present perfect.1. Sarah's hair was long. Now it is very short.Sarah has cut her hair.2. The floor was dirty. Now it is clean.The floor has been cleaned. – O chão foi limpo (by my sister)My sister has cleaned the floor. – Minha irmã limpou o chão.3. Mark's car isn’t in his garage. He is walking to work.Mark has sold his car. 4. The oven is warm and there is a cake on the table.My mother has cooked /baked a cake.5. They are standing outside because they don't have their keys.They have lost their keys.6. The ground is wet and there are puddles everywhere.It has rained.7. I am not hungry anymore. My plate is empty.I have eaten all the food. I have had lunch. 8. The TV is off and the room is quiet.My dad has slept. My dad has gone to bed.My dad has gone to sleep. 9. James has a bandage on his finger and he's in pain.James has cut his finger.James has hurt his finger.10. The email is in the draft box. Present perfect: I haven’t finished it yet.Present simple: I don’t finish any email I start. Past simple: I didn’t finish the email yesterday.11. I don't see my phone anywhere on the desk.Present perfect: It has been taken to a service shop / a technician / a repair shop.                It has been lost. Present simple: I always lose my cell phone.Past simple: I lost my cell phone yesterday.12. Her computer is off and she isn’t at her office desk. Present perfect: She had gone home.Present continuous: She is driving now.Present simple: She is happy.Past simple: She went away after class.13. The window is broken and there is a ball on the floor.14. People are leaving the cinema.15. I know this author. He’s very good.

enriched.title: Present Perfect e Vocabulário do Cotidiano
enriched.summary: A aula aborda o uso do tempo verbal Present Perfect com exemplos práticos do dia a dia. Também inclui vocabulário relacionado a ações e situações comuns, além de aspectos de pronúncia e conjugação de verbos irregulares.

vocabulary.definition: A device used for baking or roasting food.
examples: The oven is warm and there is a cake on the table.

vocabulary.definition: To cook food using dry heat, usually in an oven.
examples: My mother has baked a cake.

vocabulary.definition: To be unable to find something or fail to win something.
A small pool of liquid, usually water, on the ground.
examples: The ground is wet and there are puddles everywhere.

vocabulary.definition: A breed of dog known for its curly hair.
examples: I saw a cute poodle in the park.

vocabulary.definition: To put food into the mouth and chew and swallow it.
examples: I have eaten all the food.

vocabulary.definition: To cause pain or injury to someone or something.

grammar.explanation: Used to describe actions or events that happened at an unspecified time in the past but are relevant to the present moment.
rules: For regular verbs, the past participle is the same as the past simple form.
For irregular verbs, the past participle form must be memorized.
commonMistakes: Using simple past instead of present perfect for unspecified times.
Forgetting to use 'has' for third-person singular subjects.

practiceQuestions.question: Complete the sentence: Lisa ______ her phone. (charge)
practiceQuestions.explanation: The present perfect is used because the action has a result connected to the present (the phone is now fully charged).

practiceQuestions.question: Choose the correct sentence:
practiceQuestions.explanation: The present perfect indicates that the action of selling the car has happened and is relevant to the present.

practiceQuestions.question: Translate to English: 'Eu almocei.'
practiceQuestions.explanation: The present perfect is used to describe an action completed at an unspecified time in the past.

culturalNotes: The present perfect tense is commonly used in British English, whereas American English often prefers the simple past for similar contexts.
studyTips: Create flashcards for irregular verbs and their past participles.
Practice identifying when actions are connected to the present to use the present perfect correctly.
Pair vocabulary words with images to improve retention and understanding.
originalExamples: Lisa has charged her phone. (Lisa carregou o telefone dela.)
Sarah has cut her hair. (Sarah cortou o cabelo.)
The floor has been cleaned. (O chão foi limpo.)
Mark has sold his car. (Mark vendeu o carro dele.)
My mother has baked a cake. (Minha mãe assou um bolo.)
They have lost their keys. (Eles perderam as chaves.)
I have eaten all the food. (Eu comi toda a comida.)
My dad has gone to bed. (Meu pai foi dormir.)
James has cut his finger. (James cortou o dedo.)
James has hurt his finger. (James machucou o dedo.)
It has been taken to a service shop. (Foi levado para uma oficina.)
She had gone home. (Ela tinha ido para casa.)
She is driving now. (Ela está dirigindo agora.)
The window is broken and there is a ball on the floor. (A janela está quebrada e há uma bola no chão.)
People are leaving the cinema. (As pessoas estão saindo do cinema.)
I know this author. He’s very good. (Eu conheço esse autor. Ele é muito bom.)
